verdict.rationale: SerpApi's own Google AI Mode and Brave AI Mode engines return AI-generated answers for a query. The Brave docs explicitly mention text blocks plus references, so a developer can get a sourced LLM answer from one request. The catch is that these answers are scraped from third-party engines, not generated by SerpApi. The AI Overview API also needs a page_token from a prior Google Search call, which makes it two calls. Missing for 10: documented citation/source structure for Google AI Mode output, control over the answer generation (model, prompt, grounding), a true single-call path for AI Overviews, and hands-on corroboration of answer quality.
